Struggling to decide if I should get Escoffier: I’m a Wriothesley main and have been for some time now. I mostly play him in Freeze teams and so naturally Escoffier would be an upgrade for that. My current team is C1R0 Wriothesley/C0R1 Furina/C0R0 Vodyanitsa/C0R0 Xilonen, and I do get good numbers with it. My problem arises from the fact that I don’t like to spend too much (usually only the Welkin) and that there might be characters getting reruns in the near future that I want. I’m not that fussed about Escoffier’s character; if I were to pull her it would be purely for utility. So I suppose my question is; is she enough of an upgrade to warrant pulling her or not? Also, I should probably mention that I don’t have Skirk and am not interested in getting her, so she wouldn’t have any value there.

So if you are wondering why some of her other dialogue seems hypocritical, you would be correct.
